en: Watch the white angle arc in 3D: only 70°+ counts as a true euro carve.
tw: 看 3D 上的白色角度弧：70° 以上才算真正的低姿態刻滑。

en: The purple force line still has to run from the edge through the CoM — not be held up by the hand.
tw: 紫色力線仍然要從刃穿過重心，不是靠手撐住。

en: The purple force line runs from the loaded edge through the CoM = balanced.
tw: 紫色力線從受力的刃穿過重心 = 平衡。

en: Muscle / role (tap a row to isolate)
tw: 肌肉／作用（點一列可單獨查看）

en: Back to the hill, on the toe edge; knees push uphill.
tw: 背向下坡，用前刃；膝蓋推向上坡。

en: Back to the fall line, on the toe edge. Tap 'Toeside' to switch; you can't see downhill, so turn your head to look.
tw: 背向下坡，用腳趾那側的刃。按「Toeside」切換；看不到下方，所以要轉頭看。

en: The tibialis anterior lifts the toes; the quads and abs hold the position.
tw: 脛前肌勾起腳趾，股四頭肌和腹肌撐住。

en: Push knees and hips into the turn, shins pressing the front of the boots; press the toes (calves), glutes hold you so you don't bend at the waist.
tw: 膝蓋和髖部往彎內推，脛骨壓住雪靴前側；壓腳趾（小腿肌），臀大肌撐住不要彎腰。

en: Drive the knees forward toward the slope, press the toes lightly (calves); keep the body upright, don't bend at the waist.
tw: 膝蓋往前、往坡面推，腳趾輕壓（小腿肌出力）；身體保持直立，不要彎腰。

en: Pull the knees to the chest; the front foot levels the board.
tw: 膝蓋往胸口收，前腳把板子拉平。

en: Pull the knees to the chest; the front foot levels the board: hamstrings and abs work.
tw: 膝蓋往胸口收，前腳把板子拉平：膕旁肌、腹肌出力。

en: Crouch with weight on the tail, nose lifting: the back-foot red dot grows in the foot map.
tw: 蹲低、重心移向板尾，板頭翹起：腳掌圖後腳紅點變大。

en: Crouch down with weight over the tail, like loading a spring.
tw: 蹲低，重心移到板尾，像壓彈簧一樣。

en: The body is almost parallel to the snow and a hand can brush it, but your weight must stay over the board's edge; push knees and hips into the turn — don't put your weight on your hand.
tw: 身體和雪面幾乎平行，手可以掃雪，但重心仍然要在板子的刃上；膝蓋、髖部往彎內推，不要把體重放在手上。

en: The body leans into the turn in one straight line, hips driving toward the nose; calves and glutes hold, knees into the turn for angulation.
tw: 身體成一直線往彎內傾，髖部往板頭方向推；小腿肌和臀大肌撐住，膝蓋入彎做反弓。

en: The body leans into the turn in one line; don't push the hips back (don't bend at the waist).
tw: 身體成一直線往彎內傾，髖部不要往後頂（不要彎腰）。

en: Before spinning, twist the upper body the other way (wind-up): obliques work eccentrically.
tw: 轉之前上半身往反方向扭（wind-up），腹斜肌離心收縮。

en: Where does the rotation come from?
After the spin, flatten the board with even weight — don't sit back.
tw: 轉完雙腳平均放回平板，不要後坐。

en: Weight a little more on the front foot, head and shoulders look into the turn; the nose turns first and the back foot follows.
tw: 重心多放前腳一點，頭和肩膀看向彎的方向，板頭會先跟著轉，後腳跟上。

en: Shift weight to the front foot (back foot for a tail butter) to press the nose down while the other foot lifts the tail; wind the upper body up the opposite way.
tw: 重心移到前腳（Tail butter 則是後腳）把板頭壓低，另一腳把板尾提起；上半身往反方向預扭（wind-up）。

en: Weight onto the front foot, nose down, tail up: front foot around 85%.
tw: 重心移到前腳，板頭壓低、板尾翹起：前腳 85% 左右。

en: Re-edge to turn back uphill — this is what the bottom half of a turn feels like.
tw: 重新加立刃轉回上坡，這一下就是轉彎下半段的感覺。

en: Re-edge (heel: lift the toes; toe: drive the knees forward); the board turns back uphill and slows down.
tw: 重新加立刃（後刃：勾腳趾；前刃：膝蓋往前推），板子轉回上坡、速度慢下來。

en: Re-edge: heel side lift the toes, toe side drive the knees.
tw: 重新加立刃：後刃勾腳趾，前刃推膝蓋。

en: Land on both feet together and absorb by flexing knees and hips (quads and glutes work eccentrically), weight centred on the board.
tw: 雙腳同時落地，屈膝屈髖吸收（股四頭肌、臀大肌離心收縮），重心在板子中間。

en: Land on both feet together; the quads absorb eccentrically.
tw: 雙腳同時落地，股四頭肌「離心收縮」吸收。

en: Weight even, knees slightly bent, ready.
tw: 雙腳平均，膝蓋微彎，準備。

en: Pull both knees to the chest (hamstrings, abs); the front foot levels the board.
tw: 雙膝往胸口收（膕旁肌、腹肌），前腳把板子拉平。

en: Eccentric: the muscle lengthens while still resisting (absorbing load)
tw: 離心收縮 Eccentric：肌肉被拉長但仍然出力抵抗（吸收壓力）

en: Speed and the edge hold you up, not your hand.
tw: 靠速度和立刃撐住身體，不是靠手。

en: Face downhill and cross the slope on the heel edge; lift the toes slightly to hold the edge.
tw: 面向下坡，用後刃橫越斜坡；腳趾稍微勾起保持立刃。

en: Face downhill on the heel edge. Tap 'Heelside' to switch.
tw: 面向下坡，用腳跟那側的刃（後刃）。按「Heelside」切換。

en: Sit the hips into the turn, keep the knees bent, tibialis anterior lifting the toes, abs braced so you don't fall back.
tw: 髖部往彎內坐低，膝蓋保持彎曲，脛前肌勾住腳趾，腹肌收緊防止往後倒。

en: Hips sit low into the turn, chest forward (angulation); tibialis anterior, quads and abs hold, with the highback taking a lot of load.
tw: 髖部坐低入彎、胸口朝前（反弓）；脛前肌、股四頭肌、腹肌撐住，高背板承受很大壓力。

en: Hips sit low into the turn, chest forward; the upper body is more upright than the lower body = angulation.
tw: 髖部坐低入彎、胸口朝前；上半身比下半身更直立 = 反弓。

en: Hips nearly touch the snow, chest forward, back hand can drag; the tibialis anterior and quads work flat out against the highback.
tw: 髖部幾乎碰到雪，胸口朝前，後手可以拖雪；脛前肌和股四頭肌全力撐住高背板方向的壓力。

en: The yellow CoM line crosses over the board from one side to the other and is shorter than the board track.
tw: 黃色重心線從一側越過板子上方到另一側，路線比板痕短。

en: Side slip · Traverse + garland · Skid · Dynamic · Carving · Euro carve · Ollie/Nollie · Butter · Switch
tw: 推坡・斜滑降＋Garland・搓雪・動態・刻滑・低姿態刻滑・豚跳 Ollie／Nollie・平花 Butter・反腳 Switch

en: Interactive 3D model: muscle activation (concentric / eccentric / isometric), CoM, edge and foot pressure, viewable in 360°.
tw: 互動 3D 模型：肌肉發力（向心／離心／等長）、重心、立刃、腳掌壓力，可以 360° 旋轉。

en: Wedge · Parallel · Carving · Moguls · Short turns · Pivot slip · Traverse + garland · Inside-ski lift drill
tw: 犁式・平行式・刻滑・蘑菇・小迴轉・側滑轉向・斜滑降＋Garland・提內腳練習
3D 刻滑教學：肌肉・重心・立刃
3D 雙板教學：肌肉發力・重心・立刃

en: 6–12° is ideal for practice; too steep and you'll be forced into the back seat — see Spec.
tw: 6–12° 最適合練習；太陡會被迫後坐，見「規格設定」。

en: Adductors: bring the knee into the turn, keep skis parallel / hold the wedge
tw: 內收肌群：膝蓋帶入彎、雙腳平行／維持犁式

en: At the apex the inside ski lifts and all the weight is on the outside ski.
tw: Apex 時內腳提起，所有重量在外腳。

en: The CoM (yellow ball) sits right above the middle of the foot; shins roughly parallel to the upper body. Sitting back burns your thighs quickly and you lose control of the skis.
tw: 重心（黃球）在腳掌正上方；脛骨和上半身大致平行。後坐會讓大腿很快痠，也控制不了板子。

en: Edge and pressure are brief — don't linger in the middle of the turn.
tw: 立刃和壓力時間短，不要停在彎中。

en: Should the edge angle be greater than, equal to, or less than the body lean?
tw: 立刃角度應該大於、等於，還是小於身體傾倒？

en: Erector spinae: hold the upper body's forward lean
tw: 豎脊肌：維持上半身前傾

en: Peak GRF: outside-leg quads, glute max and glute med hold; hamstrings co-contract to protect the ACL. Outside obliques / QL create upper-body angulation; the inside leg shortens.
tw: 地面反作用力最大：外腳股四頭肌、臀大肌、臀中肌撐住；膕旁肌協同收縮保護前十字韌帶。外側腹斜肌／腰方肌做上半身反弓；內腳收短。
地面反作用力（外腳→重心）

en: Gastroc/Soleus: pressure control at the end of the turn
Glute max: hip extension, holds hip height
tw: 臀大肌：伸髖、維持髖部高度

en: Glute med: stabilises the pelvis, lateral support
tw: 臀中肌：穩定骨盆、側向支撐

en: Hamstrings: co-contract to protect the ACL; shorten the inside leg
tw: 膕旁肌：協同收縮保護前十字韌帶；內腳收短
腹斜肌／腰方肌：上半身反弓

en: Quadriceps: outside leg holds the GRF, controls knee flexion
tw: 股四頭肌：外腳撐住地面反作用力、控制屈膝

en: Rectus abd.: brings the CoM forward at the edge change
tw: 腹直肌：換刃時把重心帶向前

en: Tibialis ant.: pulls on the boot tongue to stay forward
tw: 脛前肌：拉住鞋舌保持前壓

en: ① The inside ski still carries about 10–40% of body weight (more on hard snow and at high edge angles); ② to shorten the inside leg the quads have to lengthen under control, not switch off; ③ the hamstrings and hip flexors pull the inside foot back and up to keep both feet level fore/aft; ④ the tibialis anterior keeps the inside boot tongue engaged so the inside ski doesn't sit back; ⑤ muscles around the joints co-contract to keep the knee stable and catch you if the outside ski slips. So the outside leg does the main work, and the inside leg handles 'fine-tuning and insurance'.
tw: ① 內腳仍然承受大約 10–40% 體重（雪況越硬、立刃越大，比例越高）；② 要讓內腳收短，股四頭肌要離心收縮、慢慢放，不是完全放鬆；③ 膕旁肌、髖屈肌負責把內腳拉後、拉高，讓雙腳前後一致；④ 脛前肌要拉住內腳鞋舌，不讓內腳後坐；⑤ 關節周圍肌肉協同收縮，保持膝蓋穩定，萬一外腳打滑也撐得住。所以外腳出主力，內腳負責「調節和保險」。

en: ⚠️ ${cfg.v} km/h on R${cfg.R}: the more the ski edges, the tighter it turns and the more lean it needs — there's no balance point. In reality it will skid (shown here as a ${Rt.toFixed(0)} m radius), or you need a longer-radius ski / to slow down.
tw: ⚠️ ${cfg.v} km/h 配 R${cfg.R}：板子立刃越多彎就越小，需要的傾倒就越大，找不到平衡點。實際上會打滑變搓雪（這裡用 ${Rt.toFixed(0)} m 半徑示範），或是要換 R 比較大的板／減速。

en: ⚠️ With the lean this level can manage (about ${(lv.cap/D).toFixed(0)}°), ${cfg.v} km/h needs a big ${Rt.toFixed(0)} m radius turn to hold. Too fast — slow down.
tw: ⚠️ 以這個程度做得到的傾倒（約 ${(lv.cap/D).toFixed(0)}°），${cfg.v} km/h 要轉 ${Rt.toFixed(0)} m 半徑的大彎才撐得住。太快了，應該減速。

en: ⚠️ Muscle activation is an illustrative model based on ski biomechanics literature and force-chain principles (relative values), not measured EMG. Movements are procedurally generated idealised demos for understanding cause and effect, not a reference for exact angles.
tw: ⚠️ 肌肉發力是依照滑雪生物力學文獻和力鏈原理做的示意模型（相對值），不是實測 EMG。動作是程式產生的理想化示範，用來理解因果關係，不是角度標準。

en: ⚠️ Too slow: only ${(phi/D).toFixed(0)}° of lean is needed, GRF is too low to hold the edge in a pure carve and it will tend to skid.
tw: ⚠️ 速度太慢：只需要傾倒 ${(phi/D).toFixed(0)}°，地面反作用力不夠大，很難撐起立刃純刻滑，容易又變成搓雪。

en: One cycle: ${(z1-z0).toFixed(1)} m downhill・${(x1-x0).toFixed(1)} m across・${dist.toFixed(1)} m travelled・${C.period.toFixed(1)} s
tw: 一個循環：下坡 ${(z1-z0).toFixed(1)} m・橫向 ${(x1-x0).toFixed(1)} m・行進距離 ${dist.toFixed(1)} m・時間 ${C.period.toFixed(1)} s

en: Sit back and you can't stay balanced: try Stance → Back seat to compare.
tw: 一後坐就站不穩：選「站姿 → 後坐」比較。

en: Always straight down the fall line.
tw: 一直面向正下坡（滾落線）。

en: The uphill ski is slightly ahead; pelvis and upper body face downhill.
tw: 上坡側的板稍微在前，骨盆和上半身面向下坡。

en: Uphill; the upper body then faces downhill, creating angulation.
tw: 上坡；上半身就朝下坡，形成反弓。

en: The upper body keeps facing downhill while the legs swing side to side: the obliques stay isometric throughout.
tw: 上半身一直面向下坡，下半身左右擺：看腹斜肌一直「等長收縮」。

en: Should the upper body turn with the skis?
tw: 上半身應該跟著板子轉嗎？

en: Upper body faces down the hill, legs swing underneath, pole plants set the rhythm.
tw: 上半身面向山下，腳在下面左右擺，點杖帶節奏。

en: Upper body faces downhill with hands forward; the lower body moves like suspension.
tw: 上半身面向下坡、手在前面，下半身像避震器一樣動。

en: Upper body faces downhill while the lower body turns with the skis — there's twist at the waist.
tw: 上半身面向下坡，下半身跟著板子轉，腰部有扭轉。

en: Upper body faces downhill; don't twist your shoulders to turn.
tw: 上半身面向下坡，不要用肩膀扭去轉彎。

en: Weight on the downhill ski, knees to the hill, upper body faces down; release to drop, re-edge to climb.
tw: 下坡腳承重、膝蓋推向上坡、上半身朝下坡；放刃下滑，入刃回升。

en: The downhill ski (the right one here) carries most of the weight — check the foot map.
tw: 下坡腳（這裡是右腳）承受大部分體重，看腳掌圖。

en: Extend to change edges, flex to load, upper body faces downhill.
tw: 伸展換刃、屈曲加壓、上半身面向下坡。

en: Hold the wedge, weight over the middle of the feet; to turn one way, press the opposite ski.
tw: 保持 A 字，重心在腳掌中間，想往哪邊轉就壓另一邊的腳。

en: Start at the edge of the mogul field with single bumps — 'hit, absorb, extend'; then practise planting the pole on the top of the bump.
tw: 先在蘑菇區邊緣做單顆蘑菇「撞、收、伸」；再練在蘑菇頂點杖的時機。

en: Flatten first, then the skis turn smoothly.
Extend gently to unweight so the skis change edges easily; then flex to load in the turn.
tw: 先輕輕伸展減壓，雙板容易換刃；入彎後再屈曲加壓。

en: At initiation the shins press the boot tongues (tibialis anterior working) and the tips bite first.
tw: 入彎時脛骨壓住鞋舌（脛前肌出力），板頭先咬雪。

en: At initiation, which foot should carry the most pressure?
tw: 入彎時，最大壓力應該在哪隻腳？

en: Initiation: weight to the new outside ski
Lift the inside ski (tail off the snow, tip lightly touching) to prove all your weight is really on the outside ski.
tw: 內腳提起（板尾離雪、板頭輕碰雪），證明全身重量真的在外腳上。

en: The inside ski steals pressure from the outside ski, so the outside edge doesn't hold and slips; the inside ski catches the wrong edge, giving an A-frame or scissored skis.
tw: 內腳搶了外腳的壓力，外腳的刃咬不牢、容易滑；內腳容易入錯刃，變成 A 字腿或兩支板分開（剪刀腳）。

en: The inside leg is lifted by the hamstrings bending the knee, not by the waist.
tw: 內腳靠膕旁肌屈膝提起，不是靠腰。

en: Two parallel tracks with the same spacing. The skis point slightly further into the turn than the path — that's skidding.
tw: 兩條板痕平行而且距離一樣。板子方向會比行進路線更往彎內一點，就是搓雪。

en: Both feet carry equal weight and the body returns to the middle. Keep the A-shape (wedge); don't stand up tall.
tw: 雙腳平均受力，身體回到兩板中間。保持 A 字（犁式），不要站直。

en: At the exit slowly lower the inside ski, ready to become the new outside ski.
tw: 出彎時慢慢放下內腳，準備做新的外腳。

en: Completion: control speed with the skid
Completion: ready for the next pole plant
Completion: get ready to lower it
Complete the turn on the outside ski alone: if you sit back or have weight on the inside ski you'll wobble immediately.
tw: 只靠外腳完成整個彎：後坐或重心在內腳就會馬上站不穩。

en: Top-right gauge: edge angle greater than body lean = there's angulation.
tw: 右上角儀表：立刃角度大於身體傾倒 = 有反弓。

en: Foot map (top right): red dot = centre of pressure (CoP), bigger dot = that foot carries more weight; the numbers show the left/right split.
tw: 右上角腳掌圖：紅點 = 壓力中心（CoP），點越大 = 那隻腳承受越多體重，下面數字是左右分配。

en: Concentric: the muscle shortens while producing force (e.g. standing back up)
tw: 向心收縮 Concentric：肌肉一邊縮短一邊出力（例如站起來）

en: No. The upper body roughly faces downhill; the lower body does the turning.
tw: 不應該。上半身大致面向下坡，轉彎靠下半身。

en: No. Keep the head and upper body on as smooth a line as possible.
tw: 不應該。頭和上半身盡量保持一條平順的線。

en: Do it on a medium slope, lining up start and finish on one straight line (e.g. a lift tower) to check you're not drifting sideways.
tw: 在中級坡做，起點和終點對準同一條直線（例如纜車柱），檢查自己有沒有往左右偏。

en: On a gentle slope do 'railroad tracks': no skidding, just two thin lines in the snow; feel constant pressure on the outside boot tongue.
tw: 在緩坡做 railroad track：板子不要打滑，雪上只留兩條細線；感覺外腳鞋舌一直有壓力。

en: On a gentle slope, start by lifting for 1 second per turn and gradually extend it to the whole turn.
tw: 在緩坡做，從每個彎提起 1 秒開始，慢慢延長到整個彎。

en: On a gentle slope slowly make 4–5 turns, saying 'press left' / 'press right' out loud each time; feel the pressure in the middle of the foot, not the heel.
tw: 在緩坡慢慢做 4–5 個彎，每個彎說出「壓左腳」／「壓右腳」，感覺壓力在腳掌中間，不是腳跟。

en: Pivot to change edges on the top of the bump: only the middle of the skis touches the snow there, so they turn most easily.
tw: 在蘑菇頂換刃轉向：那時只有板子中間接觸雪，最容易轉。

en: Plant the pole on the top / back of the bump to draw the body forward into the next trough.
tw: 在蘑菇頂／蘑菇背點杖，帶身體往前進入下一個凹槽。
坡度 ${cfg.slope}°・板子方向 ${Math.abs(p.psi/D).toFixed(0)}°（0° = 滾落線）

en: Release the pressure at once; the hand is already reaching forward for the next pole plant.
tw: 壓力立刻釋放，手已經往前伸準備下一次點杖。
